title: Message specificity
lesson: Describe what each level requires. Scores are expectations over indices 0 through 3, not integer labels.

specificity.instructions: Rate the specificity of the message. Choose the highest level whose description is satisfied.
criteria: Generic enquiry; no product is named and no concrete issue or request is stated.
A product is named, but there is no concrete issue or requested action.
A concrete issue or requested action is stated, but details needed to act are missing.
A concrete issue or requested action includes useful details such as reproduction steps, an order identifier or an exact requested change.

cases.state: I have a question about your calendar app.
